pages.text: Learn controlled plane mining without bypassing protections; a toolbox and sheets prepare the next engineering outing.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Excavation I selects a face-directed3×3 plane; II selects 7×7. Pickaxes, shovels and axes follow native eligibility; the white highlight previews the area. Enchantment acquisition and rank access stay native.

pages.text: Excavation I mines a face-directed3×3 plane and II7×7 using eligible pickaxe/shovel/axe with native access/durability. White highlight is presentation.
